headline: Meta reports survey estimate of AI-assisted holiday shopping in Mexico
summary: Meta’s Spanish-language newsroom summary of an Ipsos-commissioned 2025 holiday-shopping survey reports that more than one in four Mexican year-end shoppers used AI to guide purchase decisions. Meta says the online survey included 942 respondents in Mexico and was fielded across 18 markets in November 2025. The full survey and exact question wording were not accessible, so the statistic remains a source-reported result rather than a verified measure of current Mexican consumer behavior.
